messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: high-latency klaxon for service=inference-api region=us-west-2 metric=p99 latency=1287ms SLO=500ms burn=0.18
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alarm escalated to oncall. Impact: latency SLO burn crossing p99 threshold. Incident ID: INC-2024-7561
oncall-mike: acked. i'm on it — quick triage starting now.
ashley: looking at kvcache eviction spikes — hotkey behavior on user-profile embeddings. p95 creeping too.
sam: can you paste the heatmap / top keys? I can flip fallback routing for non-critical routes.
ashley: here —
```json
{"shard":"us-west-2-a","kv_evictions":1543,"queue_len":78}
```
oncall-mike: runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/latency-kv-evict — following section 2 (quick mitigations).
product-ops: customer-impact check: no error-rate bump on external dashboards, but some client timeouts reported from heavy batch jobs. tracking.
ashley: confirmed tail originates from model load on dedicated nodes when kv cache miss >5k entries, leads to synchronous disk loads.
sam: plan: route non-critical traffic -> model:inference-lite-2024 (lower-latency smaller model) for now. will apply in ~1m.
oncall-mike: please also trigger autoscale to add capacity if route doesn't cool it.
sam: applying fallback route now.
incident-bot: Note: route-change executed by sam at 2024-10-15T22:18:45Z
ashley: p99 dropped to ~610ms after route flip — big improvement :thumbsup: but still above SLO.
oncall-mike: initiating autoscale: adding 2 GPUs to dedicated pool.
product-ops: preparing internal comms template — we'll hold customer-facing notice unless this persists >15m.
lia: handoff note: i'm taking watch in 28m. mike, if still active please handoff; otherwise I'll monitor and close.
oncall-mike: will handoff if not resolved. goal: p99 < 550ms in 10m to consider alert resolved. escalate to eng-runtime (kernel/model path) if not.
sam: autoscale request submitted to dedicated autoscaler. watching metrics.
ashley: adding short incident note: fallback route + autoscale applied. collecting traces for post-incident analysis.
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by oncall-mike. Incident ID INC-2024-7561. Status: investigating.
incident-bot: Reminder: add postmortem tag if incident duration > 2h.
oncall-mike: check-ins: +5m and +15m from now.
sam: +1 for +5m.
summary: Automated PagerDuty klaxon fired for high p99 latency in us-west-2. oncall acked, fallback routing applied for non-critical traffic, autoscale requested. monitoring and handoff planned.
